description: FRA Regulated Mode Major Security Events is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This file includes event data reported to the National Transit Database (NTD) for Commuter Rail (CR) and Alaska Railroad (AR) modes, as well as Heavy Rail (HR) service reported for Port Authority Trans Hudson (NTD ID: 20098), Hybrid Rail (YR) service for the Tri-County Metropolitan Transportation District of Oregon (NTD ID: 00008), Hybrid Rail (YR) ... Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 99 columns, among them Location Type, Mode, Pedestrian in Crosswalk Serious Injuries, Rail/Bus/Ferry, Number of Derailed Cars of Involved Transit Vehicles, Current Condition. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
